name: Huntington Beach Ocean Lifeguard I (Recurrent)
org: City of Huntington Beach Fire Department, Marine Safety Division
what_you_do: Work as a seasonal ocean lifeguard on city beaches. You do ocean rescues and give first aid. You warn people about dangers in the water. You get paid during training.
who_can_apply: You must be 17 years old by July 1 of the year you are hired, with proof. You must pass a 1,000-yard pool swim in under 15 minutes and an 1,800-yard ocean run-swim-run.
pay_detail: $22.50 to $27.50 an hour in the 2026 posting. Lifeguards are paid during the academy.
duration: Seasonal, as-needed work with weekends and holidays
deadline_text: The 2026 summer posting opened Aug 12, 2025 and closed Apr 13, 2026. The exam was April 4, 2026. The 2027 summer dates are not posted on this page.
how_to_apply: Apply online on the city job site before the exam. Pass the exam and go to an interview. The best scorers join the paid training academy.
notes: A 16-year-old can apply only if they were a Huntington Beach Junior Guard last summer. Marine Safety must also back them. New hires get a uniform, fins, sunglasses and a beach parking pass. Check the city job board for the 2027 posting. Paid work under 18 in California needs a Permit to Employ and Work.
